visual_elements.description: Four small MATLAB-style plots in a 2x2 grid. Each shows ~10 blue open-circle data points sampled from a green sinusoidal curve, with a red polynomial fit of increasing order. Axes: horizontal labeled 'x' (range 0 to 1), vertical labeled 't' (range approx -1 to 1 with ticks at -1, 0, 1). Top-left (M=0): red fit is a flat horizontal line near t=0.4; a large solid red dot is overlaid on the right portion of the plot. Top-right (M=1): red fit is a straight line sloping downward from upper-left to lower-right. Bottom-left (M=3): red cubic curve closely follows the green sine wave. Bottom-right (M=9): red curve oscillates wildly, passing exactly through every blue data point with large spikes between and beyond points. Each subplot has a small yellow boxed label in its upper-right corner reading 'M = 0', 'M = 1', 'M = 3', 'M = 9' respectively.
